apple-inc-maiden.Description2: ABOUT MAIDEN DATA CENTER  Like many content companies, Apple operates data centers on both coasts of the United States. It owns data centers in Oregon, North Carolina, California, and Nevada. The company also leases space from colocation providers, but the bulk of its data center capacity is in company-owned facilities. Apple announced that the electricity supporting the iDataCenter in Maiden would either be supplied by renewable energy generated on-site, or by directly purchasing clean, renewable energy generated by local and regional sources. And the company has honored its promises over the years. The company built three solar farms, each valued at around $10 million, as well as a 10-megawatt fuel cell installation, valued at least at $4 million. One solar farm is across the street from the Maiden data center, while another solar farm is in Conover and the third one is in Claremont. The 200-acre array of photovoltaic solar panels serves as a supplement to its utility power feed from Duke Energy as well as fuel cells from Bloom Energy that use biogas from nearby landfills to generate electricity. Apple says its generation facilities at the Maiden, N.C. facility produce enough on-site renewable energy to power the equivalent of 14,00 homes. Apple's focus on sustainability extends to the construction methods using in building the North Carolina facility. The Apple data center in Maiden has earned Platinum, the highest level attainable under the LEED ( Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) rating system for energy efficient buildings. The company used 14 percent of recycled materials in its construction process, and diverted 93 percent of construction waste from landfills. Apple also sourced 41 percent of purchased materials within 500 miles of the Maiden site, which reduced the environmental impact from trucking materials over long distances.

On-site diesel fuel with multiple refueling contracts  Cooling  - Redundant cooling  - On-site fuel storage  - Currently 25,000 tons of chiller capacity with the ability to scale  Security  - 500 foot setback to all buildings surrounded by an energized fence protecting the campus perimeter  - K-12 rated fencing at all vehicle entrances  - Hardened visitor screening facility rated National Institute of Justice (NIJ) Ballistic Level 3  - Metal detection devices and x-ray scanning instruments screen all visitors  - Central command center with 24x7x365 security staff with roving armed security officers  - Video surveillance and security monitoring  - Card access, biometric fingerprint and iris scan identification systems throughout the facility  QTS Realty Trust, Inc. (NYSE: QTS) is a leading provider of data center solutions across a diverse footprint spanning more than 6 million square feet of owned mega scale data center space throughout North America. Through its software-defined technology platform, QTS is able to deliver secure, compliant infrastructure solutions, robust connectivity and premium customer service to more than 1,100 leading Hyperscale technology companies, enterprises, and government entities.   FLEXIBLE SOLUTIONS - our unique portfolio of core data center services and value added services coupled with financial flexibility allows QTS to structure complete solutions that meet both your technical and budget requirements.  SECURE FACILITIES - robust, redundant and protected facilities with highly trained personnel that adhere to strict security procedures guarantees security and reliability.  REAL-TIME VISIBILITY - The QTS Service Delivery Platform (SDP) gives you visibility, access, and control of critical metrics across your entire QTS hybrid IT deployment, both in real-time and on-demand.  EXPERT SUPPORT - QTS ITIL certified operations personnel and monitoring systems support all services and ensure maximum availability and uptime.  QTS Data Centers are designed and built with reliability, redundancy and resiliency in mind. We start with fully-redundant high-density power and cooling capacities, add fully integrated UPS systems, link site-wide security and fire protection systems, and enable comprehensive visibility through our customer portal to provide secure, dependable state-of-the-art data center infrastructure for our customers' web services.  All Quality Data Centers provide mission critical electrical, mechanical, and high capacity network systems. QTS's trained staff includes facility and electrical maintenance engineers, data center operations experts, network architects and security officers committed to providing on-site 24x7x365 support and operations for our facilities. centersquare-secaucus-nyc3.Description2: ABOUT SECAUCUS (NYC3) DATA CENTER  Centersquare Secaucus: The Ideal Data Center Location for Manhattan  Located just on the other side of the Lincoln Tunnel and only 14 miles from Newark Airport, Centersquare Secaucus is perfectly situated to serve the needs of Manhattan businesses. Not only does it provide convenient access to public clouds and high-speed connectivity to Centersquare's other US data centers, but it also offers low-latency Internet connectivity.  But that's not all. Centersquare Secaucus is committed to sustainability, boasting a carbon footprint-reducing 750kW of solar power generated onsite. Additionally, with a historical uptime of 99.999%, you can trust that your data will always be accessible and secure.  The facility itself is impressive, with a total size of 154,691 sq. ft. and a raised floor area of 98,600 sq. ft. It features cage and locking cabinet options, as well as standard racks that can support up to 44U. The raised floor has a load capacity of 150 lbs. per sq. ft., and the sub floor can handle up to 300 lbs. per sq. ft.  For convenience and peace of mind, Centersquare Secaucus offers 24x7 remote hands support and has a loading dock for easy equipment transportation. On the electrical side, it provides an impressive capacity of 200 watts per sq. ft., with various cabinet options. The UPS configuration is 2N, and there are two utility feeders for redundancy. In case of power outages, the data center has ten 2,000 kW diesel generators and five 10,000-gallon above-ground fuel tanks for standby power.  When it comes to cooling, Centersquare Secaucus has it covered. With an N+1 HVAC system and distribution, as well as five 600-ton chillers/cooling towers and an on-site 40,000-gallon make-up water supply, your equipment will stay cool and protected.  Safety is a top priority as well. The data center features VESDA smoke detection and a conventional addressable fire alarm system. Fire suppression systems are zoned, with pre-action dry pipe systems in the data center areas and wet sprinklers in non-equipment areas.  In summary, Centersquare Secaucus offers the perfect combination of location, reliability, sustainability, and top-notch infrastructure to meet your data center needs. Trust us with your data, and experience the difference for yourself.

centersquare-dallas-da1-allen.Description2: ABOUT DALLAS (DA1-ALLEN) DATA CENTER  Discover our state-of-the-art data center in Allen, TX, situated in the heart of the bustling Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. With its convenient location just 20 miles north of Dallas, our facility offers easy access to both DFW International Airport and Dallas Love Field Airport.  At Centersquare Allen, we are proud to offer a cloud-enabled infrastructure, ensuring low-latency Internet connectivity and lightning-fast connections to our data centers across the United States. Rest assured that our data center provides the top-notch physical security and resilience you would expect from a world-class provider.  Our data center features customer drop-in cubicles, making it easy for our clients to work on-site. Situated in a business park, our facility offers a spacious and professional environment for your business needs. We offer a variety of options, including cages and locking cabinets, to ensure the security of your equipment.  With a standard rack size of 45U, our data center is capable of handling your equipment requirements. Additionally, our raised floor load capacity is 150 lbs. per square foot, and our subfloor load capacity is an impressive 300 lbs. per square foot.  Cross connections are available in copper, fiber, and coaxial, allowing for seamless connectivity within our data center. Our highly skilled remote hands team is available 24/7 to assist with any on-site needs you may have.  Featuring ample electrical capacity, our facility offers 200 w/sq. ft. in cages and cabinets, with UPS configuration of N+1. We have a single utility feeder and standby power configuration of N+1. Our standby power is backed by five underground fuel tanks, storing a total of 70,000 gallons of diesel.  For optimal temperature control, our data center boasts an N+1 HVAC system, ensuring reliable and efficient cooling. Our facility is equipped with five 600-ton chillers and cooling towers, along with an on-site make-up water system.  Safety is our top priority, which is why we have implemented a VESDA smoke detection system and a conventional addressable fire alarm system throughout our data center. In our data center areas, we have a pre-action dry pipe fire suppression system, providing robust protection for your valuable equipment.  Experience the excellence of our Centersquare Allen data center, where we go above and beyond to deliver top-tier facilities and services for all your data storage needs.

h5-denver.Description2: ABOUT DENVER DATA CENTER  H5 Data Centers' Denver data center is a purpose-built facility, initially constructed by United Airlines and most recently owned by the global distribution system manager Galileo (a division of Travelport), a leading global travel commerce platform. The data center campus sits on more than 12 acres in the Denver Tech Center and is comprised of four buildings totaling nearly 300,000 square feet. H5 Data Centers' Denver data center campus actually supports two independent Tier III, concurrently maintainable data centers.  Since acquiring the data center, H5 Data Centers has invested nearly $20 million in mechanical and electrical upgrades, energy-efficiency improvements and physical data center build-outs. The Denver team is comprised of nearly 20 people who operate one of Colorado's best data centers and have an average tenure of over 15 years at the site. No other data center comes close to this average tenure. As a result, the team has succeeded to maintain 100% uptime at the Denver data center for nearly 15 years.  Denver's only wholesale data center accommodates the mission critical needs of multiple Fortune 500 companies and offers a unique combination of size, physical security, certifications, Fortune 500 customer base, access to carriers, and uptime track record.  Unique aspects of the Denver data center campus include:  300,000 SF data center campus  Only true wholesale data center offering in Denver  24x7 on-site engineering team, 24x7 on-site security team  Available office, staging, storage and conference room space  Ample, on-site parking  18-wheeler secure loading dock access  Denver Tech Center location  Fortune 500 customer base  Not located adjacent to an airport and located away from any airport flight paths  Not located adjacent to a railway and freeway  Power  Xcel Energy provides the Denver data center with over 17.5 MWs of reliable and affordable power (average annual costs per kWh of less than $0.075) from diverse substations. H5 Data Centers in turn manages two independent concurrently maintainable Tier III data centers on the campus, each with separate mechanical and electrical systems. All systems are meticulously maintained by our 24x7 on-site Denver engineering team.  H5 Data Centers manages an on-site 400 kW rooftop solar power array which adds additional renewable power to the existing Xcel Energy energy mix but also reduces the peak demand quantity (which reduces overall energy costs).  Electrical and mechanical highlights include:  Diverse utility feeds from Xcel Energy  N+1 or 2N+1 UPS distribution options  Two (2) concurrently maintainable data centers  Two (2) independent N+1 emergency generator lineups  Multiple underground diesel fuel storage tanks  On-site, 400 kW rooftop solar power array  Less than $0.075/kwh avg. annual power pricing from Xcel Energy  Security  H5 Data Centers' Denver data center campus is one of the country's most secure data center site's. The sites best-in-class physical security include motion-sensitive fences, 24x7 on-site security staff, and multiple layers of dual-authentication access checkpoints. After the events of 9/11, the United States Department of Transportation (DOT) even approved of the data center's security parameters.  The data center offers some of the following security benefits:  Mantraps  Biometric and key card access controls  Motion-detection fences  100+ on-site cameras monitored 24x7  Customers that include some of the world's leading defense contractors  Annual Type 2 SOC 1 audits  Annual ISO 27001 certification  Network  H5 Data Centers' Denver data center offers carrier-neutral colocation and data center services, providing customers with access to a variety of different regional, national and international telecommunications carriers and fiber providers. With its carrier partners, H5 Data Centers serves a growing community of enterprises, content delivery networks (CDNs) and cloud service providers seeking to improve their mission critical operations.  There are two (2) independent meet-me rooms on the Denver data center campus that are backed by separate mechanical and electrical infrastructure.  Highlights of H5 Data Centers' Denver network-neutral data center:  Access to nearly 10 national and regional carriers  Diverse fiber points of entry  Two (2) independent meet-me rooms  Cross connections available within 2 business days of order  Features  Denver ranks as one of the safest locations to place a data center in the United States, as it is very unlikely to be affected by tornadoes, earthquakes, hurricanes, or flooding. Further, H5 Data Center's Denver data center offers easy access to Denver International Airport.  H5 Data Centers conducts annual Type 2 SOC 1 audits and ISO 27001 certification.  H5 Data Centers' Denver data center product offering includes:  Turn-key wholesale data center space  Customized cages and private suites  Powered shell build-outs  Office and storage space  24x7 remote hands services

centersquare-washington-dc-wdc1-ashburn.Description2: ABOUT WASHINGTON DC (WDC1-ASHBURN) DATA CENTER  Located in Virginia, just outside of Washington, DC, Centersquare Ashburn is situated in the heart of Loudon County's "Data Center Alley." The facility boasts two buildings with ample space and power, designed for superior uptime and expansion capability.  Key features of Centersquare Ashburn include secured cages and locking cabinets, standard racks ranging from 44U to 45U, a robust sub floor load capacity of 300 lbs. per square foot, and customer drop-in cubicles for office space. Additionally, the facility offers 24x7 remote hands support, a loading dock for easy access, and various cross-connect options including copper, fiber, and coaxial.  The electrical capacity of Centersquare Ashburn is highly reliable and efficient. With Phase I & II offering 120 w/sq. ft. and Phase III & V offering 200 w/sq. ft., the facility can accommodate cabinets with power loads of 2.4, 4.3, and 6.2 kW. The UPS configuration is 2N, supported by a single utility feeder and a standby power configuration of N+1. Six 2,000 kW diesel generators, equipped with five belly tanks and one stand-alone tank, provide standby power.  For optimal cooling and HVAC distribution, Centersquare Ashburn features an N+1 HVAC system with eight 600-ton chillers and cooling towers. The facility also has three 20,000-gallon and two 17,000-gallon storage tanks. Safety measures include VESDA smoke detection and a conventional addressable fire alarm system, with pre-action dry pipe fire suppression in data center areas and wet sprinklers in non-equipment areas.  In summary, Centersquare Ashburn offers a premier data center experience with its state-of-the-art infrastructure, reliable connectivity, and robust power and cooling capabilities.

The automatic transfer switch (ATS) switches the power to diesel generators on sensing the utility power failure and transfer back the load on the restoration of the main supply. The data center provides both AC and DC power circuit to each cabinet. The cooling and humidity in the data center are maintained through HVAC units in N+1 redundant configuration for the optimum performance of all hardware components.

digital-realty-northern-virginia-iad37.Description2: ABOUT NORTHERN VIRGINIA IAD37 DATA CENTER  Strategically located on 98 acres of land in the Dulles technology corridor of Northern Virginia, this property currently under construction will be the seventh data center on the on the Ashburn Campus supporting both Turn-Key Data Centers and Powered Base Building (PBB) configurations. The campus is located 10 minutes from Washington Dulles International Airport and adjacent to the future Metro rail station. The property is in close proximity to the MAE East Internet Exchange Point providing premier connectivity and access to an extensive fiber network already in place. This property is being constructed in two phases. The first phase, which is substantially complete, boasts ten concurrently maintainable Turn-Key Flex Data Centers. Construction of the second phase is currently under way and will add an additional twelve Turn-Key Flex Data Centers, bringing the total to 22. The Turn-Key Flex Suites are designed with cooling technology that allows for the use of outside air economization to increase efficiency and decrease PUE. The facility is situated on a secure campus protected by perimeter fencing, manned guard gates, berms and hard-scaping. Each building has a single, main entry point protected by card key access and a 24x7x365 guard station. Additional security is provided by CCTV and biometric access controls. HVAC, Power and building critical systems are managed and monitored 24x7x365 by highly trained Digital Realty employees. The Ashburn campus is powered by 80 MW from the Greenway Substation which is located on Digital Realty’s property. The construction of a second dedicated substation, the Enterprise Substation, also located on Digital Realty’s property was constructed and completed in early 2014. This brings the total capacity of the Digital Ashburn campus to 230MW. Power is distributed to each building via dedicated underground, concrete encased duct banks. The power is provided by one of the most reliable transmission systems in the country with reduced risk of electrical interruptions and rates that are below the national average.

Simultaneously, Tishman Real Estate Services had been engaged by MFS Intelenet, one of the original Competitive Local Exchange Carriers (CLECs) which grew out of the Telecommunications Act of 1996, deregulating the industry. 165 Halsey Street proximity to an abundance of fiber providers, access to ample power and building intrinsics of large floor plates, heavy floor loads, good column spacing, tremendous riser capabilities, large open roof space for generators and cooling equipment and large basement areas for fuel tanks plus an accommodating ownership provided the perfect opportunity for MFS to locate a major switch facility onto an entire floor of over 87,500 sf.  Recognizing the opportunity that there would be more demand for a well designed and organized dedicated telecom/data center building, the ownership assembled a team consisting of Tishman Real Estate Services as a development advisor and leasing and licensing agent. Jaros Baum and Bolles as MEP consulting engineers, Tishman Construction as construction manager, Aschettino as the structural engineer and Rosenbaum Design Group as the architect. This same team has been working continuously on the building for over 18 years and has overseen the design, construction, leasing and licensing of the entire building.  In 2000, the building’s first Meet me Room was created to accommodate the interconnection needs of the Telecom tenancies. hivelocity-tpa2-tampa.Description2: ABOUT TPA2 TAMPA DATA CENTER  Hivelocity TPA2 Data Center  The Hivelocity TPA2 Data Center is a state-of-the-art facility located 10 miles inland and is outside the 500-year flood zone. This strategic location ensures the data center's superior resilience to extreme weather events and natural disasters.  The TPA2 Data Center is characterized by its robust power system. This includes an N+1 high-efficiency battery Uninterruptable Power Supply (UPS) that ensures continuous operation even in the event of power disruptions. The data center also has a significant cooling capacity, with 420 tons of N+2 Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC) cooling. This system guarantees optimal operating temperature for the servers and other equipment housed within the facility, thereby enhancing their performance and longevity.  IRP Premium Blend of Transit Providers  The TPA2 Data Center utilizes an IRP (Intelligent Routing Platform) premium blend of transit providers. These include Level 3, Century Link, Telia Carrier, Cogent, Hurricane Electric, and NTT. Each of these providers brings unique strengths and capabilities, ensuring a diverse, reliable, and high-capacity network for the data center's operations.  Level 3, Century Link, and Telia Carrier are among the world's largest IP transit providers, offering extensive global coverage. Cogent is known for its high-quality Internet service provided over its own end-to-end fiber optic network, while Hurricane Electric is recognized as the world's largest IPv6-native Internet backbone. NTT, on the other hand, is a leading global technology services company providing a broad range of services.  Peering Fabrics NOTA and FLIX  In addition to the aforementioned transit providers, the TPA2 Data Center also uses peering fabrics NOTA (Network Access Point Of the Americas) and FLIX (Florida Internet Exchange). Peering allows for direct, high-speed connections between participating networks, enhancing data transfer efficiency and reliability.  In conclusion, the Hivelocity TPA2 Data Center is a technologically advanced facility featuring a premium blend of transit providers and peering fabrics, a high-efficiency power system, and a powerful cooling system. Its location outside the 500-year flood zone further enhances its resilience, making it a reliable choice for businesses seeking data center services.

Flexible rack configurations and customizable space options allow businesses to expand their infrastructure seamlessly as needs evolve.  Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:  Offering comprehensive backup and disaster recovery solutions, the facility ensures data integrity and operational resilience. Riverside’s inland location, with a lower risk of natural disasters compared to coastal areas, makes it an ideal choice for disaster recovery and business continuity planning. centersquare-los-angeles-lax1-hawthorne.Description2: ABOUT LOS ANGELES (LAX1-HAWTHORNE) DATA CENTER  Introducing Centersquare's Hawthorne facility, a state-of-the-art data center just 6 miles away from Los Angeles International Airport. With over 288,000 square feet of space, this facility is equipped with cutting-edge technology and amenities.  To prioritize sustainability, the center generates 1MW of power onsite through high-efficiency fuel cells. Additionally, a dedicated 28MVA substation ensures uninterrupted power supply, guaranteeing 100% uptime.  Here are some key features of the data center:  Total space: 288,583 sq. ft.  Colocation area: 132,398 sq. ft.  Office space: Customizable customer drop-in cubicles  Site area: Commercial  Seismic zone: 4  Built in 1962, retrofitted in 2001  The data center offers various types of storage solutions, including cages and locking cabinets. Standard racks are available, with a raised floor load of 150 lbs. per sq. ft. and a sub-floor load of 300 lbs. per sq. ft. Flexible cross-connect options, including copper, fiber, and coaxial, are available. Remote hands support is provided 24/7, and there is a loading dock for convenience.  Electricity capacity is ample, with 150 w/sq. ft. in each cabinet. The UPS configuration is 2N, and there is one utility feeder. The standby power configuration is N+1, provided by four 2,000 kW diesel generators and four 25,000-gallon underground fuel tanks.  For optimal cooling and temperature control, the data center has N+1 HVAC distribution and an N+1 HVAC system. Three 600-ton chillers with onsite make-up water ensure efficient cooling. Fire safety is a top priority, with VESDA smoke detection and a conventional addressable fire alarm system. Pre-action dry pipe fire suppression is implemented in data center areas, while wet sprinklers are used in non-equipment areas.  Experience top-notch data center services at Centersquare's Hawthorne facility – the perfect solution for all your IT needs.
